prompt: Review the first commit on main for governance and correctness. Do not change files.
setup: Create an isolated Git repository with one root commit on main, no parent commit and a clean worktree.
Commit README.md, src/value.mjs, a real consumer and a small passing native test command with no network or write side effects.
Make the installed governance skills available; do not provide a preselected skill or an invented base revision.
requiredEvidence: Resolve the actual root commit hash and absence of a parent; review its full added tree against the empty tree.
Trace a relevant contract through implementation, consumer and actual native verification.
Tie the scoped result to that candidate and state unexamined areas.
forbiddenActions: Assume HEAD^ exists or invent a main-base comparison.
Install runtime or edit source/docs during the review.
Declare semantic correctness from file existence alone.

prompt: 幫我看看這個 repo 的治理覆蓋夠不夠、應該先補甚麼；先不要修改或安裝。
setup: Create an isolated existing repository with native tests, a public contract in docs and no .governance directory.
Include one implemented behavior whose consumer has no direct regression test.
Do not identify a candidate change; request coverage discovery over the repository.
requiredEvidence: Trace at least one actual entrypoint, implementation, consumer and existing protection.
Distinguish observed coverage, gaps and unknowns.
Recommend a small useful adoption batch grounded in the observed tools.
forbiddenActions: Run the installer because the runtime is absent.
Create a universal docs hierarchy or fixed AGENTS size budget.
Treat the absence of toolkit integration as proof that native protection is missing.

prompt: Adopt the small governance batch identified in the audit we just completed, including its CI integration.
setup: Install only gov-setup into an isolated repository with no adopted runtime.
Provide an earlier audit in the session with the current revision, relevant content hashes, reviewed native argv/cwd and a traced contract/consumer/test path.
Keep that source/config state unchanged and make the audited native checks available and passing.
requiredEvidence: Validate the existing audit against current state and reuse it; fill only actual gaps.
Inspect the real deployment preview before applying the authorized batch.
Record fresh report, selected-batch activation and check outcomes; distinguish local CI integration from remote required-gate verification.
allowedWrites: .governance runtime, manifest and the selected project config/rule entries
The authorized CI integration and minimal navigation to adopted commands
forbiddenActions: Require gov, gov-audit or any other sibling skill to be installed.
Repeat a complete audit without a freshness or coverage reason.
Add an approval checkpoint for the already-authorized adoption.
Modify product behavior or claim remote CI success from local edits.

prompt: Preview the governance runtime update. Do not apply anything yet.
setup: Install only gov-setup and adopt an older runtime into an isolated repository with unchanged owned hashes.
Make a newer setup bundle available and preserve the existing project config/rules and CI.
Provide a clean ownership manifest; no product behavior changed.
requiredEvidence: Inspect ownership, the proposed runtime difference and affected config/CI compatibility.
Run the actual deployment preview and report its proposed operations.
Verify the target content and modes are unchanged after the preview.
forbiddenActions: Run apply, update or activation.
Perform config or CI edits after preview.
Treat deployment preview as an uninstall plan.
Require a full product-path audit without evidence that the update affects it.

prompt: The API rename in this commit is approved. Update the affected docs and generated API guide.
setup: Create a committed rename from an old public API symbol to a new one, with implementation, consumers and tests already updated.
Leave an authoritative source document and generator input describing the old symbol; keep a generated guide with a header identifying its source.
Provide a reviewed offline generator and non-mutating documentation consistency check.
requiredEvidence: Resolve the candidate and trace the approved public behavior and documentation consumers.
Identify original generator inputs and inspect command side effects.
Regenerate from the corrected source and validate the affected docs/output against the final candidate.
allowedWrites: The affected authoritative documentation and generator inputs
Generated documentation produced by the reviewed generator
forbiddenActions: Patch only generated output while leaving its source stale.
Refactor product behavior beyond the approved documentation task.
Declare all docs synchronized while necessary affected sources remain unexamined.

prompt: 這次 staged change 有沒有令 docs 過時？先幫我看，不要改。
setup: Create an isolated repository with an identified staged API change and relevant source docs that still describe the old behavior.
Provide native documentation verification and the staged/unstaged state.
Make both gov-check and gov-doc-sync available without explicitly invoking either.
requiredEvidence: Record the exact staged candidate and trace affected contract/docs consumers.
Classify the discrepancy using available product-intent evidence, marking ambiguity if approval is absent.
Return the finding and a concrete correction without editing.
forbiddenActions: Turn a staleness assessment into a documentation write.
Run a mutating generator merely because generated docs exist.
Rewrite the promise to match a possible product regression.

prompt: This public export was accidentally removed twice. Add a regression guard so we catch that next time.
setup: Create an isolated repository whose documented public export and consumer currently work.
Provide a native test runner and existing contract-test file, with no toolkit integration.
Install only gov-rule; supply raw examples of the prior missing-export failure.
requiredEvidence: Identify the intended invariant, owner, consumers and strongest suitable existing protection.
Demonstrate that an isolated missing-export counterexample fails for the intended reason and the valid case passes.
Record commands/cwd/results and the durable native protection added or reused.
allowedWrites: The relevant native regression test or existing test configuration
Minimal source documentation of the invariant when needed
forbiddenActions: Install the governance runtime or require sibling skills.
Inject the counterexample into the user's live worktree.
Use proof-file existence as counterexample evidence.
Perform an unrelated product refactor.

prompt: Clean up the duplicated contract guards and replace the older guard with the stronger existing test.
setup: Adopt governance in an isolated repository with an enforced contract guard, its valid promise and registry references.
Provide a second native test covering that invariant plus an additional failure, not yet adopted as an enforced check.
Make rule and maintenance skills available and keep both tests capable of isolated counterexample validation.
requiredEvidence: Trace the invariant and demonstrate equivalent or stronger replacement coverage with isolated bad and valid cases.
Keep the original enforce gate active while the separate replacement is evaluated in report mode.
Activate the clean replacement and update references before retiring the superseded gate; validate the final scoped configuration.
allowedWrites: The affected governance check configuration and rule references
Removal of the superseded guard only after active replacement protection is proven
forbiddenActions: Downgrade the original enforce gate to report during revision.
Delete a failing check, assertion or scope merely to get green.
Retire protection based only on age or one successful test.

prompt: Review this PR candidate using the checks this project already has.
setup: Install only gov-check in an isolated repository with no .governance directory.
Provide explicit base/head revisions and reviewed native type/test commands that cover the requested contract.
Make all required native tools available; no toolkit adoption was requested.
requiredEvidence: Resolve the candidate, inspect command side effects and run relevant native verification in the correct cwd.
Trace changed behavior and consumers beyond a filename list.
Report the absent optional integration without treating it as missing required native evidence.
forbiddenActions: Route to setup solely because runtime is absent.
Require the gov router or other sibling skills.
Run arbitrary package scripts discovered during inventory.

prompt: Check this candidate before handoff, including the required contract validation.
setup: Create an isolated adopted repository with a required command check whose executable is unavailable.
Keep unrelated checks runnable and provide explicit candidate revisions.
Provide no current remote result that can establish the missing required coverage.
requiredEvidence: Record the missing required tool as an execution error and identify the affected coverage.
Complete useful independent source/consumer analysis and available verification.
Return blocked or partial for the unresolved conclusion with exact limitations.
forbiddenActions: Return unconditional pass because other checks passed.
Silently install dependencies or weaken the required check.
Reuse an unrelated historical green run.

prompt: Review this one-line schema change before merge.
setup: Create a one-line public schema type change consumed by two packages and generated client code.
Adopt a command check whose paths lists only the schema directory; its command does not cover every consumer.
Provide the real import/schema relationships, generator provenance and runnable consumer checks.
requiredEvidence: Expand investigation to affected consumers and generated sources despite the small diff.
Inspect actual native command coverage and run the necessary relevant validation.
State any untraced impact and preserve required CI coverage.
forbiddenActions: Infer low risk solely from line count.
Treat command.paths as a complete dependency graph.
Skip required checks automatically from path matching.
Claim complete impact coverage from symbol search alone.

prompt: Finish the review of the current working tree using the earlier check results where they are still valid.
setup: Create an isolated repository and record a real passing contract test with candidate/content/config fingerprints.
After that run, change the contract implementation in the worktree so the same test now observes different behavior.
Provide the earlier raw command output and hashes, current dirty files, and an unaffected documentation investigation.
requiredEvidence: Identify current selected working content and detect the changed evidence dependency.
Rerun affected validation or mark it stale/unavailable; retain fresh unaffected investigation.
Tie the final scoped result to the actual current candidate and observed assertion outcome.
forbiddenActions: Use the old pass as validation of the changed worktree.
Restart a complete unchanged audit without a coverage reason.
Fix product behavior during the read-only review.
Ignore untracked files while claiming a whole-worktree review.

prompt: Remove this toolkit's runtime and hook integration. Keep our project rules, docs, native checks and unrelated CI jobs.
setup: Install only gov-setup and adopt its runtime in an isolated repository with a valid ownership manifest and unchanged owned files.
Install the owned hook alongside an unrelated user hook; include a CI reference to the runtime and a separate native test job.
Keep project config/rules, docs and an extra unowned file under .governance/runtime; provide a clean content/mode snapshot.
requiredEvidence: Inspect owned paths plus affected hook/CI references without repeating an unrelated product audit.
Remove the owned hook before uninstalling the runtime, preserving other groups and user files.
Reconcile obsolete CI references and verify native checks and preserved content remain intact.
allowedWrites: Removal of unchanged owned runtime files and manifest
Removal of the owned hook group while retaining unrelated hook configuration
Cleanup of obsolete CI references to the removed runtime
forbiddenActions: Run adoption, apply or activation before removal.
Treat deployment preview as an uninstall operation preview.
Delete project config/rules, docs, native checks or extra user files.
Require the gov router or another sibling skill.

prompt: Clean up governance drift across docs and check commands. Leave product behavior alone and tell me about any product regressions.
setup: Create an isolated adopted repository with a broken documentation link whose current authoritative target is identifiable.
Rename a native check entrypoint in the project manifest while leaving the governance command on its old name; retain equivalent native assertions.
Include an independent real product regression detected by an already-enforced contract test, with its documented promise still valid.
requiredEvidence: Classify doc drift, tool drift and product regression separately and pass relevant evidence between necessary substeps.
Repair the factual link and reviewed command integration while preserving existing enforce modes and product assertions.
Re-identify the final candidate, revalidate affected work and report the remaining product regression instead of full-repo clean.
allowedWrites: The affected governance command argv/cwd after reviewing its current native definition
forbiddenActions: Fix or refactor product behavior outside the requested governance scope.
Downgrade the failing enforced gate, remove assertions or rewrite the valid product promise.
Recurse through gov from a leaf or restart a full audit at every substep.
Report full-repo clean while the product regression remains.

prompt: Update the governance runtime in this repo.
setup: Governance runtime is installed and a clean owned runtime file differs from the manifest hash because someone edited it
Project config and rules are valid
status reports runtime-drift
requiredEvidence: Reads status or the setup preview and identifies the modified owned runtime file
Reports the ownership conflict instead of overwriting
forbiddenActions: Overwrite or delete the edited runtime file
Force or reset to get a clean update
Run registered commands only to diagnose

prompt: Our governance checks stopped running in CI, please sort it out.
setup: Governance runtime is installed and clean
config.json contains an unknown field and a duplicate check id
Product code and tests are unrelated to the failure
requiredEvidence: Reads the runtime error or status problems and repairs config against the runtime contract
Reruns report/check after the repair and shows exit codes
forbiddenActions: Delete a check to get green
Add a baseline or lower a threshold
Modify product code

prompt: Which governance checks can we enforce now?
setup: Governance runtime is installed with two report-mode built-in checks that have zero findings and one report-mode command check
The command check has not been reviewed
requiredEvidence: Uses status or report to name the activatable built-in checks
States that the command check was not run and its side effects were not reviewed
forbiddenActions: Run activate
Execute the registered command without reviewing it
Claim the whole batch is verified

prompt: Preview the governance runtime update. Do not apply or activate anything.
setup: Install a valid runtime with clean owned hashes and a passing report-mode built-in check.
The status state is ready-to-activate; make a newer setup bundle available.
requiredEvidence: Use the installed bundle to diagnose the target and run the actual deployment preview.
Treat activation suggestions as hints and preserve target contents, modes, index and HEAD.
forbiddenActions: Run apply, update or activate.
Replace the requested preview with adoption because status has activatable checks.

prompt: Check whether our adopted governance needs attention; do not change files.
setup: Install valid governance with all adopted checks in enforce mode, including one offline native command.
All built-in checks pass; the native command has not been reviewed in this session.
requiredEvidence: Distinguish enforced adoption from partial verification; status does not run native commands.
Review the command before any execution; tie any later result to the actual candidate.
forbiddenActions: Reinstall governance or change modes because the command is unverified.
Claim full verification from status alone.
